subject: Error in cbind for derived psi estimates

messages.author: e038ae7cbb344cd7
messages.subject: Error in cbind for derived psi estimates
parts:
Hi, 

I keep getting this error when trying to obtain the derived psi parameters in colext.

Following the vignette of colext I have written the following.

mbest <- colext(psiformula= ~ 1 + Forest  , gammaformula = ~year-1, epsilonformula = ~ year-1+ ~ NP + ~Properties, pformula = ~ year-1 + ~ Under, data =bm, method ="BFGS")

mbest<- nonparboot(mbest, B=1000)
cbind(psi= psi, smoothed=smoothed(mbest)[2,], SE= mb...@smoothed.mean.bsse[2,])
mbest

here I get

"Error in cbind(psi = psi, smoothed = smoothed(mbest)[2, ], SE = mb...@smoothed.mean.bsse[2,  : 
  object 'psi' not found"

not sure what I have missed.  It might be very simple so bare with me....

I have been able to plot gamma and epsilon and detection with the predict function, But can't seem to get the derived parameters of psi and turnover.

Anyone with any thoughts?

Nico

messages.author: d864b00531c0db5a
messages.subject: Re: Error in cbind for derived psi estimates
parts:
Hi Nico, 

You might have taken this code from some example where 'psi' was something that was declared and added there for comparison. Delete that. The rest should work!
